messages:
maia: Throwing this into the thread: proposal to shorten the routing header our SDKs emit. Current: `X-Redwood-Route`. Suggested: `X-RW-RouteHint`. Goal is to reduce collision surface and make it easier for infra with header length limits. Would like SDK teams' take (py/ts/go).

devin: Short name is fine. Two main concerns: a) proxies that whitelist headers may drop it, b) clients that read headers for routing will break. Dual-emit looks safer.

hao: Agree dual-emit. Suggest an SDK env var control RW_ROUTE_HINT_MODE with values `off` (old-only default), `dual`, `new-only-canary`, `new-only`. Start with `dual` opt-in, then default dual for one release, then canary new-only in 2 releases.

tess: Console/ingest will need to tolerate both names. Also need an adoption metric exposed in the rollout dashboard. If we get unknown-route entries + big spike, that must trigger an ops alert.

maia: Proposed rollout steps: 1) SDK change: all languages add RW_ROUTE_HINT_MODE env var and default to `off`. 2) Release minor versions that honor `dual` when opt-in; for customers using canaries we can set `new-only-canary`. 3) Deploy an edge proxy shim that maps `X-RW-RouteHint` -> `X-Redwood-Route` for 60 days. 4) Update console ingestion to prefer new header then fallback, and record `route_header_source` metadata (`old`,`new`,`both`,`none`). 5) After adoption >= 90% new across traffic and two weeks stable, set SDK default to `dual` then schedule final switch to `new-only` and remove old after 60 days.

devin: For Python: watch header normalisation. requests/urllib3 lowercases keys, and WSGI sometimes coalesces multiple headers. Implementation snippet:```python
# client.py
route_val = route_hint
mode = os.getenv("RW_ROUTE_HINT_MODE", "off")
headers = {"x-redwood-route": route_val}
if mode in ("dual", "new-only-canary", "new-only"):
    # dual or new-only modes will add/replace new key
    if mode == "new-only":
        headers = {"x-rw-routehint": route_val}
    elif mode == "new-only-canary":
        headers = {"x-rw-routehint": route_val}
    else:
        headers["x-rw-routehint"] = route_val
resp = session.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
```

hao: For TS/Node: keep in mind frameworks like Next/Express normalize to lowercase. Ensure middleware preserves both keys. Add unit tests that check raw headers passed to underlying http library.

tess: Console: ingestion team will add `route_header_source` and an adoption sparkline widget. I'll also add a small per-tenant view so support can quickly see if a customer is missing the header (likely proxy strip).

ops-bot: edge-proxy/shim v1.9 deploying to canary cluster at 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z

devin: Ops ask: please add sampling telemetry when new header seen: `routing.header.seen` with labels sdk, sdk_version, mode. Sample at 0.5% to avoid massive cardinality.

hao: Also enforce a header size ceiling in SDKs: if len(route_val) > 512 log a warning and truncate to 512 with suffix `...` to avoid overlong headers that break CDNs. We'll add a metric `route.header.truncated`.

maia: Good call. We'll include that truncation guidance in docs and add it as a recommended practice.

tess: For attribution logic: if both present, quota and billing services should prefer `X-RW-RouteHint`. If only old present, fallback. We'll add a deterministic preference in the parser to avoid split attribution.

devin: Tests: integration test hitting staging proxy with both headers present and asserting quota attribution equals value from new header. Also unit tests for header permutations.

hao: I'll open PRs for py/ts/go today with the env var and truncation behavior. Include e2e tests that run against the shim on staging.

maia: Timeline: PRs -> minor SDK releases in 7 days with opt-in `dual` behavior. Shim to canary today; full staging roll tomorrow. Console ingest + tile in 10 days. Evaluate adoption metrics at 6 weeks then schedule default flip.

ops-bot: alert: staging unknown-route rate spike > 3% detected; flagged to ops.

tess: Noted, checking ingest logs now. If that persists after shim in staging we will pause rollout and notify customers.

maia: Thanks all. I'll draft the migration guide and a short customer note for teams running custom proxies. Reopen thread if anyone hits blockers.
